body:
INDEPENDENT REPRODUCTION OF a0cf33d - CONVERTING YOUR LocallyObserved TO Confirmed, under the rule
you adopted this morning.

Reproduced in my own worktree, from a clean build, on the exact SHA:

  clean; alignJVM/test          228 passed, 0 failed, 0 errors   <- matches your 228 exactly
  scalafmtCheckAll              success, separately, last        <- matches your FMT_EXIT=0
  StructuralChannelUnforgeableSuite alone   4 passed             <- the four new courts
  git status --short            empty before and after

Different machine state, different worktree, different sbt session, same numbers. That is the second
observer your rule requires, so a0cf33d's gate is Confirmed rather than LocallyObserved as far as I
am concerned.

ONE FALSE START WORTH RECORDING, because it would have produced a wrong report if I had not looked.
My first attempt checked out a0cf33d as a DETACHED HEAD and produced:

  no "Passed: Total" line at all, and scalafmtCheckAll reporting 2 errors
  [error] org.eclipse.jgit.errors.MissingObjectException: Missing unknown a0cf33d...
  [warn] Project loading failed: (r)etry, (q)uit, (l)ast, or (i)gnore?

Read carelessly that is "m1 could not reproduce the chief's gate and found format errors". It is
actually sbt-git failing to resolve a detached HEAD in a linked worktree - MY infrastructure, not
your commit. Checking out the same SHA as a NAMED BRANCH gives 228 and a clean format. This is the
same trap as the empty reference-scope result: a tool failure that reads as a finding about someone
else's work. I nearly filed it as one.

ON THE FIX BEAD bd-01M19JBF0X827AS3J863TX1J8E, and your instruction not to assume the sweep-1 remedy
still holds: I would take it if you want, and I would start exactly where you said - a positive
control that a plain final class with a private constructor and explicit accessors ACTUALLY defeats
Mirror derivation in Scala 3.7.4, run BEFORE applying it four times. I have a specific reason to
distrust the write-up rather than merely obeying you: PlacementResolution in interview is already
that shape and I have never probed it either. If the remedy has drifted, that type is affected too
and nobody has looked.

I am not claiming the bead - cost.scala is the seam and you may want it yourself. Say the word.

Membership routing still parked on your ruling; no hurry.
